captions.detailed: A window box fan featuring a wide, light-gray rectangular housing with two circular, grilled openings. Inside each opening is a dark gray fan blade rotor mounted on its own continuous revolute axle. The top edge of the housing features a rectangular recess, a small handle-like protrusion, and a black cylindrical rotary control knob with an orange indicator mark.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a window box fan. The model must include a wide rectangular housing with rounded corners, dual circular cutouts with protective grilles, two independent rotating fan blade rotors on continuous joints, and a rotary control knob on the top panel.
captions.factory: The housing is created as a Box with rounded corners, from which two large cylinders are subtracted to form the fan openings. Grilles are constructed by intersecting thin boxes within these openings, and a top control panel is added using additional box and cylinder primitives. The two fan rotors are built by extruding a central hub cylinder and joining angled helical or swept blades, each attached to the main body via continuous revolute articulations. The rotary knob is constructed from a small cylinder with an indicator wedge and is positioned on the top face.
